[{"severity":"MEDIUM","file":"packages/teamlead/src/bridge/ship-relevant-diff.ts","line":401,"title":"Docs-only exemptions now re-read PR metadata on every 3s GatePoller tick (~1,200 gh calls/hr per pending docs-only gate) — the round-3 throttle was reopened for the release side, and the 60s max-age safety net already bounds the risk a 30s sub-lease would leave","detail":"This commit restricts the metadata sub-lease (introduced to fix my round-3 HIGH) to `cached.ship_relevant === 1` (line 402-405). For a cached `ship_relevant === 0` snapshot the sub-lease is skipped, so `ensure()` issues `await input.api('/repos/{repo}/pulls/{n}')` (line 414) on every call (test `ship-relevant-diff.test.ts` "revalidates a docs-only exemption every time" pins exactly this: a metadata read at now=0 AND now=3_000). `ensure()` is driven by `GatePoller`, which calls `ensureShipRelevantDiff` unconditionally for every pending `approve_to_ship` question on every `pollIntervalMs: 3_000` tick (gate-poller.ts:753-755, no N-tick guard; production `input.api` is an `execFileP("gh", …)` subprocess, plugin.ts). A docs-only PR classifies `ship_relevant=0`, the gate is RELEASED (holdReason null) and relayed, but the question stays pending until the founder responds — so every 3s for the whole awaiting-founder window it spawns one `gh` process ≈ **1,200 calls/hr per pending docs-only gate**, vs ~120/hr at the round-4 APPROVED commit.

Blast radius: the fleet shares one `gh` credential against GitHub's 5,000 req/hr primary REST limit; that budget also feeds Runner PR creation, `gh pr merge` on the ship path, and CI-status reads. In this project docs-only PRs are frequent (the doc/ archive pipeline) and the founder is routinely away for hours (per project memory), so a docs-only gate can sit pending overnight generating 1,200/hr, and a few stacked overnight approach the shared ceiling — degrading unrelated critical-path operations for the rest of each hour.

Why the extra cost buys little: the synchronous authorization read already enforces a 60s max-age lease (auto-qa-held.ts:160-170) and `metadataRetryMs` already defaults to `min(30_000, MAX_AGE/2)` = 30s. Re-reading on the 30s sub-lease for `ship_relevant=0` too would keep the docs-only exemption at most 30s stale — well inside the 60s lease that fails closed if refresh stalls — while cutting cost ~10x. The marginal correctness gain of per-tick (≤3s vs ≤30s exposure to a same-head base-retarget race between revalidation and a founder click) is small next to that cost. Recommend applying the metadata sub-lease to both classifications (or a short dedicated docs-only interval ≤ half the max-age lease); the TOCTOU guard in `classifyShipRelevantDiff` (the genuine correctness fix in this commit) is unaffected and should stay."}]
